about.title: Your UAE-based aviation parts supplier and leasing partner
about.description: AERBAVS MRO Parts & Leasing FZCO is a Dubai-based aviation supply company dedicated to keeping aircraft airworthy and fleets operational. Established in 2020 and operating from Dubai Digital Park, Dubai Silicon Oasis, we supply certified aircraft and engine parts, aviation tools, hangar supplies, consumables, and leasing solutions to airlines, MRO organisations, operators, and defence aviation units across the Middle East, Central Africa, South Asia, and beyond.

items.title: Tools and Equipment
items.body: Specialist aviation maintenance tools, pneumatic riveters, torque wrenches, and precision equipment for MRO facilities and line maintenance operations.

items.title: Shop & Hangar Supplies
items.body: Ground support equipment, workstands, jacks, handling equipment, and all infrastructure supplies required for efficient hangar operations.

items.title: Aircraft & Engine Parts
items.body: Certified rotables, LRUs, airframe and engine components with full 8130-3 / EASA Form 1 documentation from OEMs and approved repair stations.

items.title: Avionics & Instruments
items.body: Flight instruments, navigation systems, communication equipment, and avionics components with full certification and trace documentation.

items.title: Adhesives
items.body: Aviation-grade epoxy systems, film adhesives, and structural bonding compounds approved for aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul applications.

items.title: Lubricants
items.body: Aerospace lubricants, hydraulic fluids, and greases meeting OEM specifications for airframes, engines, landing gear, and flight control systems.

items.title: Sealants
items.body: Polysulfide, polyurethane, and compound sealants for fuel tanks, pressurised structures, windows, and aircraft exterior applications.

items.title: Silicones
items.body: High-performance silicone compounds, RTV sealants, and dielectric greases approved for aviation electrical, structural, and environmental sealing.

items.title: Cleaners
items.body: Aviation surface cleaners, degreasers, solvent wipes, and aqueous cleaning systems formulated for aircraft surfaces, interiors, and components.

items.title: Coatings
items.body: Primers, topcoats, corrosion inhibitors, and specialised aviation coatings qualified for aircraft interior, exterior, and structural paint systems.

items.title: Tapes
items.body: High-performance aviation tapes — aluminium foil, speed tape, edge tape, surface protection, and speciality tapes approved for aircraft maintenance.

items.title: Accessories
items.body: Aviation electrical accessories, connector pins, circuit breakers, aircraft batteries, wire harnesses, and specialist maintenance accessories.

faq.title: Answers for airlines, MROs, and procurement teams.
faq.description: Everything you need to know about AERBAVS aviation parts supply, leasing, AOG response, and worldwide delivery.

items.q: What types of aviation parts and materials does AERBAVS supply?
items.a: AERBAVS supplies a comprehensive range of aviation products including aircraft and engine parts (rotables, LRUs, expendables, avionics), aviation tools and ground equipment, hangar and shop supplies, adhesives and sealants, lubricants and silicones, cleaners and coatings, aviation tapes, and all aircraft consumables and expendable materials. We also offer aircraft leasing solutions.

items.q: How do you handle AOG — Aircraft on Ground — requests?
items.a: Our dedicated AOG desk is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. For AOG emergencies, call us directly at +971 54 176 1644. We prioritise AOG requests immediately — sourcing parts, booking priority airfreight, and coordinating delivery to minimise your aircraft ground time. You can also email info@aerbavs.com or sales@aerbavs.com with full part details.

items.q: What aircraft leasing options does AERBAVS offer?
items.a: AERBAVS facilitates dry lease, wet lease (ACMI), and short-term lease arrangements for commercial aircraft. We work with lessors and aircraft owners to match available assets with operator requirements, and support the full transaction including technical records review, delivery condition inspection, and lease documentation.

items.q: Do you ship internationally? Which regions do you cover?
items.a: Yes, AERBAVS ships worldwide. Our primary markets include the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman), Central Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia), South Asia (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka), and many other global destinations. We handle DG (dangerous goods) cargo, customs clearance, and priority airfreight from our Dubai hub.

items.q: Where are you located and what are your operating hours?
items.a: AERBAVS MRO Parts & Leasing FZCO is headquartered at Building A1, Dubai Digital Park, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, UAE. Our standard office hours are Sunday to Thursday, 09:00–18:00 GST. Our AOG desk is available 24/7, 365 days a year. Contact us at +971 54 176 1644, info@aerbavs.com, or sales@aerbavs.com.

items.q: How do I submit an RFQ or parts request?
items.a: You can submit your RFQ through the contact form on our website, by email to info@aerbavs.com or sales@aerbavs.com, or by calling +971 54 176 1644. Please include part numbers, ATA chapter, quantity required, condition (new/serviceable/overhauled), documentation requirements, and your target delivery date. We aim to respond to all RFQs within 24 hours.
